title: No real physicists on the program

tellings.quote: >> There wasn't a real physicist there. Nobody at the PhD level who is either an applied physicist or an or a theoretical physicist

plain: A secret programme had no proper physicists working on it, according to the physicist Eric W. Davis, quoted on the show: "There wasn't a real physicist there. Nobody at the PhD level who is either an applied physicist or a theoretical physicist." He does not say more about which programme he means. If true, whatever was being studied was in the hands of people without the training to understand it.
